what: an 8 x 5 rectangle swept along a path of a 30 mm vertical line and a 40 mm horizontal line meeting at a sharp corner (walls mitred)
method: in the bend plane the mitred joint keeps the area w (l1 + l2): the outer side gains exactly what the inner side loses, so V = A (l1 + l2) = 40 * 70 = 2800. bbox: x -4..40, y +-2.5, z 0..34 (the mitred outer corner reaches 30 + 4).
